title: Lucid merging into mallworld
content: Hey all, I don’t want to offend or upset anyone here so please be nice 🙏🏻 I just want to understand and make sure I’m in the right place with you all. But I’m m becoming concerned about this mallworld family merging slowly into lucid dreaming. There are already lucid dreaming etc etc groups on here and although I know I can be lucid, I didn’t like it, I find it a dangerous and scary practice. Basically ’m not an active lucid dreamer because I don’t want to f@£k with stuff I don’t fully understand. Ie our brain and mallworld. …. However, there’s a rapid increase of mallworld lucidity tests/requests/discussion appearing. It makes me really uncomfortable but I really love this mallworld family I’ve found. Something I thought only I was experiencing has led me to a whole new world of kindred souls and I feel really accepted and loved. So Help me out please friends. If I’m not a willing lucid mallworlder and if it’s giving me chills to see them merge, do you think I should leave?
